en.headline: Korean band LUCY holds Island encore concert at Kitty Woo Stadium tonight
en.dek: The group performs at 7pm on Tuesday at Tung Po's Kitty Woo Stadium as part of its ninth concert tour encore, with tickets previously sold via Cityline.
body: Korean band LUCY is scheduled to perform its 2026 9th Concert Island Encore in Hong Kong at 7pm on Tuesday at Kitty Woo Stadium in Tung Po.

Organised through Live Nation and Cityline, the show features the four-member group known for its violin, six-string bass and dual-vocal lineup. Tickets ranged from HK$799 for seated to HK$1,399 for VIP packages when they went on sale in August.
The concert follows the band's recent Seoul encore dates. Standing zones are restricted to those aged 12 or above and at least 140cm tall, while seated areas allow those aged 3 or above.

zh.headline: 韓國樂隊LUCY今晚東蒲胡李名靜體育館舉行Island安可演唱會
zh.dek: 樂隊周二晚上7時在東蒲體育館演出，作為第九次演唱會巡演安可場，門票早前經Cityline發售。
body: 韓國樂隊LUCY定於周二晚上7時在東蒲胡李名靜體育館舉行2026年第九次演唱會Island安可場。
演出由Live Nation及Cityline安排，四位成員以小提琴、六弦貝斯及雙主唱編制見稱。門票於8月發售時，坐位為799港元，VIP套票為1399港元。
是次演出在樂隊最近首爾安可場之後舉行。企位區限12歲或以上及身高不少於140厘米人士，座位區則容許3歲或以上人士。
